verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a Webhooks API that sends real-time HTTP notifications of platform changes over HTTPS, with subscriptions to multiple event categories. The only concrete event types shown are payment status and hosted-payment completion or failure, so the data-freshness events this story asks for are not evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence that webhooks are signed or verifiable, event types for new transactions, balance updates and consent or connection state changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
